name: Payments from or for third parties unrelated to the underlying trade
description: Payments are made by parties with no apparent link to the underlying transaction, goods or services.
fp: Group companies, agents or financiers may pay on behalf of the principal.

links.name: Payments from third parties unrelated to the trade
links.ctx: Invoices are settled by firms that are not named in trade documents, often from high-risk or diversion-prone jurisdictions.
links.fp: Treasury centres and group payment arrangements are common.

links.name: Payments for bunkers, port fees or crew from unrelated parties
links.ctx: Operating costs paid by third parties unconnected to the shipowner or charterer.
links.fp: Ship agents pay on behalf of owners.

links.name: Payments by parties in different jurisdictions with no trade link
links.ctx: Settlement arrives from unrelated entity or country relative to the trade parties.
links.fp: Third-party settlement is not unusual in supply chains.

links.name: Maintenance, crew or insurance costs paid by third parties
links.ctx: Running costs of an asset are paid by persons unconnected to the registered owner.
links.fp: Managers pay on behalf of owners.
